WHAT IT DOES. A head with the server's summary and the document's notes behind a "Why this order" disclosure; the census painted from the CARD STREAM (never from `sections`) with a heading per section; the seam as its own quiet element; an IntersectionObserver on links.next with the same door as a "Further back" button; the honest terminal sentence when the archive runs out. Per population: do-now = title + teaser + tap chips; ticklers = three verdicts + the subject link; insights = finding + evidence + the offer PRIMARY + both verdicts + a raw-principal byline badge; fuel and archive = read-only panels wearing the server's own sentence. Dispatch is on the card's WIRE SHAPE, not on kind names — an app's kinds have no business inside the framework's page.

THE ORIGIN. Every verb sends Idempotency-Key: feed/<day>/<card_id percent-encoded>/<nonce>, minted per tap. A verb with an input or a confirmation opens the ordinary dialog, which grew ONE optional argument (idemKey) so a card verb counts either way. `heavier` renders as a LINK to the row's screen, never a POST. After a verb lands the card settles on the row's FRESH envelope and the chips do not come back — re-deriving the ≤-selection partition client-side would be a second opinion about what fits under a thumb. A refusal renders on the card that asked for it, in the engine's own sentence.

VERIFIED BY HAND, and the walk is a script now: waymark10/scripts/feed-smoke.sh (boots chromium, runs `ui-drive.mjs feed` — a new third mode that seeds its own day through the API — then reads the audit trail). 19 checks, no console errors, and four rows of `feed/2026-08-24/do_now%2Ftask%2F…/<nonce>` on waymark10_transitions: actions-from-the-feed is live, per day, per section, per kind.
